text:
noemi (People Ops): sharing a compact "T-shirt + impact" goal template we've been trialing — meant to help teams quickly size scope and capture the user impact narrative for OKRs + reviews. use in kickoff, self-reviews, or PR descriptions.

noemi (People Ops): key idea: add a short effort size (XS/S/M/L) and a 1-line user-impact sentence. helps reviewers and managers calibrate fast.

noemi (People Ops): ```T-shirt + impact goal card (pasteable)
Objective: <one-sentence outcome>
Owner: <name>  |  Effort: <XS/S/M/L>
T-shirt rationale (1 line): why this size?
Impact sentence: <what changes for users/customers when done>
Top 2 signals (metric/artifact):
  1) <metric or artifact link + baseline -> target>
  2) <customer quote / activation signal>
Top risk (one line) + mitigation idea
Immediate next step (owner + due date + effort tag)
Peer asks (0-2 things you need from other teams)
Evidence items to collect for review (2 links or numbers)
Behavioral snapshot for manager (one line): "I want feedback on: <stakeholder communication / ownership / tradeoffs>"
```

ravi (eng-manager): nice. the behavioral snapshot is gold for reviews. quick suggestion: add a tiny "rollback/fallback" note for risky KRs.

noemi (People Ops): added a short fallback line under "Top risk" in the snippet.

tara (product): can we add a micro-template for peer feedback that maps to the card? keeps things aligned in reviews.

noemi (People Ops): good call. paste this alongside the card as a 3-line peer feedback prompt: 

```Peer micro-feedback (3 lines)
1) One concrete thing they did that moved the needle: <short + link>
2) One suggestion to improve impact or speed: <short, actionable>
3) One behavior to call out (owner/communication/clarity): <short>
```

jun (ic): for cross-functional KRs where I'm not owner, is it ok to use the card to document contributions?

noemi (People Ops): absolutely — annotate the card with "contributor: <name>" and list the artifact. recommended phrasing: "Contributed: owned infra work PR #123 (reduced rollout time by X days)."

ops-bot: :pushpin: Pinned the card + peer prompts to #people-ops-resources and added a quick-copy button to the handbook.

ravi (eng-manager): rolling this out in my team OKR kickoff tomorrow. will share any language tweaks. thanks! :rocket:
